caption: The drawing features a metal object with the primary structure composed of two elongated rods bent into a heart-like shape that converge at one end, where they are joined by a handle with a circular hole near its end. The object has three short legs attached to the bottom, allowing it to stand elevated above a surface. The drawing presents the object from two different angles: a side view and a perspective view, with the side view located above the perspective view. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, indicating a metallic texture. Directly beneath the side view, there is a simple linear scale marked with measurements for reference. The drawing is executed on a plain, off-white background with no additional decorative elements, and the artist’s signature “Stanley H. Ebison” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Trivet
